memories.content: On 2026-08-30 Nautilus approved Daniel's transfer to Toronto; the move is signed with a start date of 2026-10-01, resolving the long-distance 'who relocates' question in Mara's favour.
Daniel is keeping the same firm in the Toronto move, so Mara feels it is not a sacrifice that could curdle into resentment, which had been her fear.
Daniel planned to fly to Toronto the last weekend of September 2026 to flat-hunt with Mara, with the possibility of them living together.
When Mara told her mother about Daniel's move (2026-08-30) her mother cried and immediately asked about marriage; Chidi sent a thumbs up and 'took him long enough.'
Even Priya, who Mara describes as allergic to sentiment, said she was happy for Mara about Daniel's move (2026-08-30).

entities.name: Priya
entities.description: Mara's close friend and fellow ICU nurse; distinct from manager Priyanka

memories.content: Mara called Daniel's approved Toronto move the best news in a brutal year, the long-distance distance finally having an end date of 2026-10-01.
